name: Anghelina
text: Anghelina here, the bike store door has been jamming since the rain started n i nearly missed my train, can someone oil the runners today

name: Laber
text: Laber opened ticket 8102 this morning: the flat roof over the laundry drips onto the fuse box whenever it rains, and the sealant the last contractor used has already peeled away

name: Bumbacco Drugmanne
text: Bumbacco Drugmanne reported ticket 6641 at seven this morning: both lifts in the north tower stopped between floors within ten minutes of each other, trapping two residents for nearly half an hour each, and the alarm company wants the logs pulled before the insurer asks questions

name: Virna Nadjeschda
text: Virna Nadjeschda flagged the broken hand dryer in the west washroom again, the sensor clicks but no air comes out and the paper towels ran out yesterday

name: Moiz
text: Moiz logged case 4407 after the fire panel started beeping at the front desk every four minutes, the panel shows a fault on zone 6 but nobody can find which device keeps tripping it

name: Alexe
text: Alexe raised ticket 9014 about the car park barrier that now drops without warning: two wing mirrors were clipped this week alone, the sensor arm was replaced last month and the fault keeps coming back, and drivers have started using the delivery lane to get out

name: Sahel Dewa
text: Sahel Dewa reported the roundabout sign at the depot entrance has lost two bolts and swings in the wind, and the post leans toward the road

name: Haj Kadour
text: Haj Kadour opened case 3320 this afternoon: the cold tap in the staff kitchen runs warm for a full minute before it settles, and the water heater has started knocking when the dishwasher draws at the same time

name: Yiwei
text: Yiwei logged ticket 7702 after the night porter found the loading bay doors propped open at two in the morning, the lock plate is worn so the bolt slides back on its own, and the depot manager wants a proper repair rather than another round of adjustments, the last fix lasted nine days

name: Cotten
text: Cotten reported ticket 5568: the visitor kiosk screen has a dead stripe down the middle and the card reader keeps asking for the pin twice

name: Sagunthala Hemphill
text: Sagunthala Hemphill flagged the wet patch under the water coolers on floor two, it comes back every time the cleaners mop and the tiles have started lifting, someone should look before its a trip claim

name: Schurr Somaruga Aktashi
text: Schurr Somaruga Aktashi raised ticket 4820 about the recycling compound gate that no longer latches, foxes have been in twice this week and the bags are spread across the lane, the hinge post has rotted through at the base and needs the concrete collar replacing, not just a new latch

name: Amanuel
text:
Amanuel, the lift maintenance visit has moved from tuesday to thursday so the barriers will go up a day later, sorry for the shuffle, thanks,
Site Office

name: Mao
text:
Mao, your locker request has been approved and the fob is waiting at reception, the invoice for the deposit will follow by email, please collect it before friday as we only hold unclaimed fobs for a week after the notice goes out, thanks,
Facilities Desk

name: Koneswaran Kipili
text:
Koneswaran Kipili, the surveyor needs access to the rear garden on wednesday morning, the side gate must stay unlocked from eight and the shed key is under the usual pot, if the dog will be out please let the office know so the visit can be rearranged, thanks,
Estates Office

name: Ionela-Andreea Szybka
text:
Ionela-Andreea Szybka, the pay and display machine on level three is card only this week, the coin slot is blocked and the engineer comes friday, thanks,
Car Park Office

name: Johna
text:
Johna, the crèche registration form for the summer term is missing the emergency contact page, could you drop it in by friday, the first session runs on the eighth and we need the full pack before then, thanks,
Childcare Team

name: Viebahn
text:
Viebahn, the mains water test on tuesday means the kitchen and both washrooms will be off between nine and one, bottled water is being delivered to the canteen on monday afternoon, please move any food prep to the morning and reschedule the cleaner for after two, thanks,
Building Office

name: Von Zobeltitz
text:
Von Zobeltitz, the bin collection day shifts to monday next week, please put the containers out sunday evening, thanks,
Waste Team

name: El Rherabi
text:
El Rherabi, the interview panel for the new technician runs thursday from ten, your slot is at eleven twenty and the room is the small meeting suite, bring photo id for the gate and ask for me at the desk, thanks,
HR Office

name: Israël
text:
Israël, the boiler service on the nineteenth needs the cupboard cleared and the loft hatch left open, the engineer will be with you between eight and ten and the whole visit takes about three hours, if the weather turns icy please salt the path to the gate so he can get the kit in safely, thanks,
Property Office

name: Bissinger
text:
Bissinger, the vending contract renewal is due and the new prices start in june, forms are at the desk, thanks,
Catering Office

name: John Smith
text:
John Smith, your order 4471 has been split because the second item is on backorder until the ninth, the first parcel goes out tonight and the rest follows when it lands, tracking updates within a day, thanks,
Orders Team

name: Aruni Terracini
text:
Aruni Terracini, the studio booking for the podcast has been moved to bay two because the acoustic panels in bay one are being replaced, the mics and headphones are already set up and the sound check is booked for half an hour before, if you need the extra chair let the desk know today, thanks,
Media Office

name: Maryléne
text: Ticket 6210 came in overnight about the chip shop extractor smell drifting into the flats above, Maryléne logged it with the environmental team and a visit is booked

name: Laver
text: Case 3389 is about the balcony lights that stay on all night and shine into the bedrooms next door. Laver measured the spill with a meter and confirmed the light head is aimed wrong. A shield or a re-aim will be quoted this week.

name: Manali Imrane
text: Report 7301 covers the recurring draught through the main hall doors that has pushed the heating bill up. Manali Imrane traced it to worn seals on both leaves and a gap at the threshold plate. The seals can be replaced but the threshold needs the door taken off its hinges. A quote for both is going to the committee.

name: Gressa Chowfla
text: Ticket 8115: the stairwell handrail came loose above the second landing, Gressa Chowfla wobbled it on the morning round and the fixings went straight onto the urgent list

name: Ljubinko
text: Ticket 5097 concerns the gym mirrors that arrived chipped on the bottom edge, Ljubinko took photos at delivery for the claim, two of the three panels are affected and the supplier refuses to process it without the shots.

name: Makhmudov
text: Case 6644 tracks the squeaking door on the consultation room that no amount of oil will quiet. The hinge plates are bent from the last refit, and Makhmudov found the top screw pulling out of the frame during the asset check. The whole leaf needs rehanging and the frame plugging before the clinic reopens.

name: Zayneb Zekhout
text: Ticket 2298: the kitchen window catch snapped off in the cold snap, Zayneb Zekhout taped it shut as a stopgap and ordered the replacement handle

name: Prestele Battocchio
text: Report 4412: the trolley bay signs were installed last tuesday and two are already missing, Prestele Battocchio checked the fixings on the others and found the adhesive pads too weak. Bolted plates are being ordered instead.

name: Marius-Stefan
text: Ticket 9930 came in after the site hoist failed its weekly inspection, the brake shoes are past the wear mark and the engineer who visited says the drum also needs machining. Marius-Stefan has grounded the hoist until the parts land and moved the crews onto the north scaffold, the supplier has promised the kit within four days.

name: Dávila
text: Case 8851: the logbook app keeps logging drivers out mid shift, Dávila cleared the tokens and the fault hasnt returned

name: Ninho Aksayan
text: Ticket 3077: the community noticeboard has been vandalised twice this month, Ninho Aksayan photographed the damage and fitted the lockable case from stores. Keys went to the office and the glass panel is on order.

name: Ardesi Melnychuk
text: Report 5180: the swimming pool shower drains have been slow for weeks and the water sits an inch deep by the end of each session. Ardesi Melnychuk rodded both runs from the access pit and pulled out a mat of hair and plaster dust, the flow is back to normal and a grill has been fitted over the pit mouth.

name: Diliet
text: Ticket 4489: the doorbell in the shared hall hasnt worked since the rewire, Diliet swapped the transformer and it rings again

name: Adília
text:
Subject: Order collection times. The warehouse will only release collections before two from now on, so Adília please book the van for the morning run. Anything urgent can still go by courier at the old rate if you flag it by ten.
Thanks,
Depot Office

name: Okbay
text:
Subject: Training room refresh. The new desks arrive friday and the old ones go to the youth club. Okbay has the layout plan for the fitters and will tape the floor on wednesday. If the ceiling lights are still flickering, report it before the works start so the electrician can add it to the visit.
Thanks,
Premises

name: Onik Rosende
text:
Subject: Key fob audit. Two fobs are still signed out to the old tenant, so Onik Rosende will suspend them tonight. The replacements are at the desk.
Thanks,
Housing

name: Semiz Melion Koffel
text:
Subject: Platform lift service. The lift will be out of use wednesday morning while the brake is adjusted. Semiz Melion Koffel has the engineer booked for eight and the parts are on site. The stairlift cover is on the same visit.
Thanks,
Access Team

name: Samuella
text:
Subject: Canteen price review. The till rolls show the soup and sandwich deal is running at a loss, so Samuella has repriced the board from the first of next month. The new menus are at the printer and the update goes up friday. The loyalty stamps stay as they are.
Thanks,
Catering

name: Narancic
text:
Subject: Window cleaning. The crew comes monday at eight. Narancic has left the access code in the usual envelope.
Regards,
Estates Team

name: Ben Slimene
text:
Subject: Clinic room booking. The podiatry clinic needs the consulting room on tuesdays for six weeks starting the third. Ben Slimene has checked the diary and the slot is free apart from one week. Please confirm the setup by friday.
Thanks,
Rooms Office

name: Bréville Ballim
text:
Subject: Festival stall allocations. The revised plan puts the food stalls along the wall and the craft tables by the gate so the walkway stays clear. Bréville Ballim has measured the frontage and two stalls will need to share a power point unless the genny is hired.
Thanks,
Events

name: Cabdalla
text:
Subject: Skip permit. The permit for the skip runs out friday, so Cabdalla needs the swap booked before the weekend.
Thanks,
Site Team

name: Sahinkaya
text:
Subject: Deliveries over the bank holiday. Nothing will move on monday, so all orders must be in by friday noon. Sahinkaya will run the emergency line from home and the depot keys stay with the duty manager.
Thanks,
Logistics

name: Sancar Faiq
text:
Subject: Weekend cover rota. The saturday shift is short two people for the open days and the sunday list is still being checked. Sancar Faiq has asked the agency for names by thursday and will confirm the times once the bookings close. Anyone swapping must put it in the book.
Thanks,
Rota Office

name: Haralambos Daouda
text:
Subject: Tool store tidy up. The shelves are labelled and the sign out book is back, Haralambos Daouda returns the drill bits monday.
Thanks,
Workshop

name: Dreissigacker
text:
Subject: Meeting room kit. The screen in room two has lost its remote again. Dreissigacker has moved the spare kit in for monday and flagged the hdmi lead for replacement before the friday session.
Thanks,
Office Team
